meta.source: Shrine list, trial names, locations and treasure from zelda.fandom.com (facts); solutions written in our own words from those pages.

shrines.name: Dah Hesho Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout II; the pillars can be broken by bombs or its spin attack. The gate then opens to the monk and the chest.

shrines.name: Kah Mael Shrine
shrines.solution: Stand on the low end of the big seesaw and use Magnesis to drop the barrel or the metal box onto the high end so you get flung upward, then glide to the monk. While airborne you can instead glide right to a ledge with the chest.

shrines.name: Ke'nai Shakah Shrine
shrines.solution: Blow open the cracked rocks in Ulria Grotto (Bomb Arrows while gliding work) to find the entrance. Defeat the Guardian Scout III and the gate to the monk opens; the chest is behind it.

shrines.name: Ritaag Zumo Shrine
shrines.solution: Carry the nearby Ancient Orb to the pedestal at the centre of Rist Peninsula to raise the shrine.

shrines.name: Tutsuwa Nima Shrine
shrines.solution: Offer Dinraal's scale at the Spring of Power to open the shrine, then beat the Guardian Scout IV. The shallow water lets you use Cryonis and electricity against it.

shrines.name: Ze Kasho Shrine
shrines.solution: Tilt the spiked platform until the spikes slide apart into a path, then hit the Shock Switch (re-hitting it from range) so the flipping panels block the lasers as you cross. In the last room, tilt the maze so all three orbs sit on their switches together. For the chest, ride the rotating platform up and glide to the ledge right of the exit door.

shrines.name: Tu Ka'loh Shrine
shrines.solution: Find your way through the Lomei Labyrinth Island maze, then follow the spiral path up to the shrine.

shrines.name: Katosa Aug Shrine
shrines.solution: Tilt the hammer with motion control to knock the launched Ancient Orb into the slot across the room; the moving platform then carries you to the monk. Behind the monk, repeat with an angled shot to reach the chest.

shrines.name: Zuna Kai Shrine
shrines.solution: Reach the top of the spire on the eastern island of Skull Lake (the skull's left eye).

shrines.name: Etsu Korima Shrine
shrines.solution: Follow the torches and glowing walls past the lasers, spinning spike columns and fire jets, beat the three Guardian Scouts, then climb the stairs. Burn the vines under the wooden platform in the spike-column room to drop the chest.

shrines.name: Ja Baij Shrine
shrines.solution: Take the Remote Bomb rune and bomb the cracked walls. Ride the moving platform with a cube bomb on it and detonate it at the far walls, then send a bomb along the right-hand launcher in the last room to clear the way to the monk. One chest is behind a bombable wall to the right of the first hallway; the other is reached by riding the left launcher in the last room.

shrines.name: Keh Namut Shrine
shrines.solution: Collect Cryonis, climb an ice pillar to the ledge, and raise the portcullis with a pillar beneath it. Past the Guardian Scout, push up one end of the balanced slab with ice to make a ramp to the monk; an ice block also reaches the chest ledge near the Scout.

shrines.name: Oman Au Shrine
shrines.solution: Get Magnesis from the pedestal, lift the floor slabs to find the ladder, and pull the metal cube out to topple the block wall. Beat the Guardian Scout, swing a metal slab to bridge the last platforms, and pull open the metal doors. Lower the chest from the ledge above with Magnesis.

shrines.name: Owa Daim Shrine
shrines.solution: Freeze the spinning gear to cross on the slab, freeze the rolling boulder to walk up the ramp, then freeze the last boulder, whack it with the sledgehammer and let it fly out of the way. The chest sits behind where the boulder drops; reach it while the boulder is frozen.

shrines.name: Rohta Chigah Shrine
shrines.solution: Lay a metal path over the floor spikes with Magnesis, then freeze the second gear and the second conveyor belt with Stasis. Glide past the swinging spiked balls, step on the floor switch and outrun the advancing spike wall, climbing a launcher at the end to glide to the monk. The chest sits right of the first spike floor; reach it with Magnesis.

shrines.name: Ruvo Korbah Shrine
shrines.solution: Beat the Guardian Scout IV, then stand on the back room's floor switch to lower the arena platform. Fight through the Scouts below, use the Small Key on the portcullis, and defeat the final four Scouts to open the way to the monk.

shrines.name: Yowaka Ita Shrine
shrines.solution: Grab the metal bowl with Magnesis and use it to catch the rolling orbs. Drop the small orb in the slot by the entrance to open the monk's gate; the large orb's slot opens a side room with a chest, and a second chest can be caught with the bowl.

shrines.name: Bosh Kala Shrine
shrines.solution: Open the paraglider in front of each fan and ride the gusts to the monk's ledge at the far end. Glide from the left-hand fan to a chest near the entrance, and drop from the monk's platform to a second chest across from it.

shrines.name: Dah Kaso Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout II to open the gate to the monk; the chest is behind the same gate.

shrines.name: Kaam Ya'tak Shrine
shrines.solution: Smash each stone door with a boulder: swing the first via Magnesis or Stasis, burn wooden supports to release others, use the hammer and Stasis to freeze tilting floors. At the end, stand on the Launcher and hit the Shock Switch to fly up to the monk.

shrines.name: Katah Chuki Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout II that rises in the arena to open the gate to the monk and the chest.

shrines.name: Monya Toma Shrine
shrines.solution: Smash the wooden boxes in front of the second launcher and use the Shock Switch to aim the third, then set the orb on the first launcher so it bounces through the chain into the slot. Turn the chest toward the second launcher with the switch and launch yourself to it.

shrines.name: Namika Ozz Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout III to open the gate to the monk; the chest is behind the same gate.

shrines.name: Noya Neha Shrine
shrines.solution: Burn away the thorns at the cave entrance, then defeat the Guardian Scout II to open the portcullis to the monk.

shrines.name: Saas Ko'sah Shrine
shrines.solution: Beat the Guardian Scout IV; the room has no pillars, so lift the floor metal blocks with Magnesis for cover. The chest is behind the gate that opens.

shrines.name: Wahgo Katta Shrine
shrines.solution: Stack the metal blocks under the ledge holding the metal slab and climb up to it. Then stack the blocks under the monk's ledge and drop the slab onto its edge as a ramp to climb. The chest is on top of the platform the blocks lean against.

shrines.name: Zalta Wa Shrine
shrines.solution: Shoot the balanced orb into its slot to free a second orb, then hold the floor switch and throw that orb into the small room to set the upper structure moving. Stand on the Launcher, hit the Shock Switch to fly into the structure, and follow it up to the monk.

shrines.name: Mijah Rokee Shrine
shrines.solution: Stand on the pedestal at Washa's Bluff wearing no armor during a Blood Moon to raise the shrine, then defeat the Guardian Scout III inside.

shrines.name: Maag No'rah Shrine
shrines.solution: Blow up the cracked rock hiding a cave in the Upland Lindor cliff face, south of the Bokoblin camp.

shrines.name: Mogg Latan Shrine
shrines.solution: Ride the swinging platforms (pull the still one with Magnesis to set it moving), shoot the ropes to drop the bridge, and get past the hanging spiked balls. Ride the rail platform, arrange the rail platforms into stairs, then burn the leaves on the door (fire arrow, flint or the lantern) and pull the doors open with Magnesis. Chests: right side of the fourth platform, behind the last spiked ball, and behind the staircase platforms.

shrines.name: Shae Loya Shrine
shrines.solution: Freeze the big orb mid-air with Stasis and shoot it so it drops into the slot, starting a second Launcher. Ride that Launcher up and shoot the hidden Shock Switch to open the monk's portcullis; shoot the ropes above the entrance to drop one chest.

shrines.name: Shira Gomar Shrine
shrines.solution: Glide across on the fans, sending Remote Bombs along the air currents (or using Bomb Arrows) to break each blocking wall. Freeze the Wind Switch with Stasis so the gate stays up while you glide past the spinning gear. A chest sits on a platform near the gear.

shrines.name: Toh Yahsa Shrine
shrines.solution: Bomb the block pile to uncover a metal box, then use it with Magnesis to climb across and finally to hold down the big floor switch under the second ladder, which opens the gate. Knock the chest off the ledge right of the entrance with the box, and bomb the wall under the entry platform for the second.

shrines.name: Daqa Koh Shrine
shrines.solution: Stand on the big launched block and freeze it with Stasis at the moment the generator touches the ceiling connector, then glide into the opened cell. The chest is on a platform in a corner you can glide to from the raised block.

shrines.name: Gorae Torr Shrine
shrines.solution: Finish the Gut Check Rock climb, grabbing at least 100 rupees within three minutes, so Bayge steps aside.

shrines.name: Kamia Omuna Shrine
shrines.solution: Load a Remote Bomb into each cannon, aim it with the Shock Switch, and detonate to fire an orb at the glowing targets. Tilt the second target's frame with the motion control pedestal to get a clear shot. Shoot down the chest by the first cannon and pull it out with Magnesis.

shrines.name: Kayra Mah Shrine
shrines.solution: Climb the slope while dodging or freezing the iron balls and spiked boulders, ignoring the rupee bait until every trap has rolled; then walk to the top. Both chests along the walls are reached by gliding from higher up.

shrines.name: Mirro Shaz Shrine
shrines.solution: Freeze the orb with Stasis, line up behind it and hit it five times with the sledgehammer so it lands in the slot. Then freeze the block on the rail and hit it upward to tip the slab into a ramp to the monk. For the optional last chest, repeat the orb shot with five sledgehammer hits plus one hit from a smaller weapon.

shrines.name: Mo'a Keet Shrine
shrines.solution: Freeze the rolling boulder with Stasis to get up the first ramp. On the second floor, carry the Iron Ball with Magnesis to shove aside the boulders on the left ramp, which leads to the monk.

shrines.name: Qua Raym Shrine
shrines.solution: Burn the crate off the left scale, take the key from the chest that drops, and free the three steel blocks. Raise a Remote Bomb on a scale to blast the blocks below the monk, then spread the steel blocks across the scales so one lifts you up without hitting the spikes.

shrines.name: Rinu Honika Shrine
shrines.solution: Bomb or Magnesis away the fire-spewing columns and use the steel blocks to shield the flames, stacking two to slip through the fiery gate. At the end, tilt the platform with the gyro control and glide to the monk. A steel block also bridges the lava to the chest.

shrines.name: Sah Dahaj Shrine
shrines.solution: Knock the fallen torch into the vines to burn open a passage, then cut the hanging lamp's cable to burn the next vines. Ignite the vines leading to the crates holding the slab so it drops on the floor switch and opens the door. Burn the vines under the hanging chest to drop it.

shrines.name: Shae Mo'sah Shrine
shrines.solution: Drop or swing lamps to burn vines, freeing stone barrels to weigh down floor switches and an Iron Ball to turn a wheel. Grab the Small Key, open the door left of the first ramp, and use a barrel (or Stasis) on the last switch to reach the monk.

shrines.name: Sharo Lun Shrine
shrines.solution: Ride the hanging blocks along the conveyor tracks, clinging to their sides to dodge fire and spikes. Use Cryonis to climb the waterfalls to the monk; catch the falling chest at the first waterfall with an ice block.

shrines.name: Shora Hah Shrine
shrines.solution: Carry blue flame from lit pedestals to unlit ones using wooden weapons, torches or fire arrows, freezing water spouts with Stasis and moving metal blocks with Magnesis as needed. Finish by spin-attacking with a lit weapon to light the seven pedestals at once and open the last door.

shrines.name: Tah Muhl Shrine
shrines.solution: Carry fire from the torches (wooden weapon or arrow) to burn the vines and crates into the next room. Burn the crates holding up the ramp to lower it to the monk. The chests in this room are freed by burning vines and crates; one holds a key you float over the bars with Magnesis to open the locked cell.

shrines.name: Daag Chokah Shrine
shrines.solution: Follow Oaki from the Korok Forest to the shrine without letting him spot you.

shrines.name: Keo Ruug Shrine
shrines.solution: Count how often each constellation appears on the mural, then drop orbs into the holes whose number of blue lights matches. A second mural behind the wall gives the order for the chest's gate.

shrines.name: Ketoh Wawai Shrine
shrines.solution: Follow the bird-shaped torches through the dark Thyphlo Ruins to a Blue Hinox, take the orb from its neck and set it in the nearby pedestal.

shrines.name: Kuhn Sidajj Shrine
shrines.solution: Follow the trail of Ogre Trees holding metal boulders through the Lost Woods, feed a Rusty Shield to one to get the chest from its partner, and return that chest to the Ogre Tree on the island in Lake Saria.

shrines.name: Maag Halan Shrine
shrines.solution: Walk Damia's path using only the Forest Dweller's sword, shield and bow without any of them burning or breaking.

shrines.name: Ka'o Makagh Shrine
shrines.solution: Open the metal doors with Magnesis, bomb the blocks holding the loose door, then carry that door around as a bridge between the platforms to reach the monk. Use Magnesis to spot a fake wall block hiding a chest.

shrines.name: Pumaag Nitae Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout II to raise the gate; the chest is behind it.

shrines.name: Shae Katha Shrine
shrines.solution: Hit Farosh to get one of its scales and drop it into the Spring of Courage to open the wall behind the Goddess Statue.

shrines.name: Shoqa Tatone Shrine
shrines.solution: Photograph a Guardian Skywatcher, Scout and Stalker for Loone, take her orb and set it in the pedestal, then defeat the Guardian Scout III inside.

shrines.name: Ya Naga Shrine
shrines.solution: Blast a bomb under the stone cube to fling it up the rail and break the cracked ceiling (Stasis or Bomb Arrows help). Then ride the launched cube up to the monk's floor.

shrines.name: Dako Tah Shrine
shrines.solution: Use Magnesis to set the metal cube where it powers each switch, riding the platforms it activates, then place it in the round slot and ride the last platform, pushing the big cube aside. Chests hide on the rising platform, the upper room, under the shortcut lift and behind the big cube.

shrines.name: Daqo Chisay Shrine
shrines.solution: Use Magnesis to bridge gaps in the floor wiring with the metal barrels, cubes and the chest, carrying power to the switches that open each door. Finish by putting both big cubes on either side of the platform before the last room to power the final door.

shrines.name: Hawa Koth Shrine
shrines.solution: Use Magnesis to bridge current with metal cubes and the chained charged ball, then carry the charged ball across the walkway without touching its switches. In the last room, line up the cube switches to free the gear, and slot the gear into the wall to open the monk's door.

shrines.name: Keive Tala Shrine
shrines.solution: Use Magnesis to place the three metal crates in the gaps of the wall circuit to open the gate. Lining up four platforms with the motion control pedestal completes the circuit further and opens the chest room.

shrines.name: Kema Zoos Shrine
shrines.solution: Stop the charged ball with Stasis (then knock it off course with an arrow, or freeze it in a launcher), and drag it with Magnesis next to the switch right of the monk's gate. Placing it by the hidden switch on the left opens the chest.

shrines.name: Korsh O'hu Shrine
shrines.solution: Find the marked spheres in the East Gerudo Ruins and place each one in front of the Heroine statue with the matching symbol.

shrines.name: Misae Suma Shrine
shrines.solution: Fetch ice from the Northern Icehouse for Furosa's drink, then tell Pokki so she leaves the shrine terminal.

shrines.name: Raqa Zunzo Shrine
shrines.solution: Beat Tali's Sand-Seal racing record, then put the Grand Trophy orb into the pedestal to raise the shrine.

shrines.name: Takama Shiri Shrine
shrines.solution: Slide the metal cubes and railed platforms with Magnesis to complete each circuit and open the gates, without standing on live metal unless you wear rubber gear. A switch in the third room opens the chest.

shrines.name: Tho Kayu Shrine
shrines.solution: Light the four torches on the rocks around the area while avoiding or defeating the Molduga.

shrines.name: Dila Maag Shrine
shrines.solution: Find your way through the South Lomei Labyrinth to the shrine.

shrines.name: Jee Noh Shrine
shrines.solution: Freeze the orb on the conveyors and shoot it into its slot, twice (watch the Guardian Scouts in room two). In the last room carry the orb against the belt, timing the laser blocks and freezing the middle laser, then slot it. Jump to the chest on the opposite belt.

shrines.name: Joloo Nah Shrine
shrines.solution: Tilt the first cube until every switch touches the electricity, turn the fan cube to hit all four wind switches (hold the low ones up with the metal cube and Stasis), then light every torch on the last cube while dodging the water spouts. One chest is reached by riding the fan wind; the other drops when you burn the leaves above the lantern.

shrines.name: Kay Noh Shrine
shrines.solution: Set the charged ball in its slot to open the door, then cut the next ball down and slot it to slide the block into place. Take the Small Key through the locked door and arrange the four metal cubes in the water to carry current to both switches.

shrines.name: Keeha Yoog Shrine
shrines.solution: Shoot a Shock Arrow at the pedestal in the middle of the lightning mural on the Gerudo Summit cliff to raise the shrine.

shrines.name: Kema Kosassa Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout IV to open the gate; the chest is behind it.

shrines.name: Kihiro Moh Shrine
shrines.solution: Count each color of sphere in the ceiling gyroscope and place each colored orb in the matching numbered slot of its row (red 1, green 2, yellow 2, purple 4). For the chest, drop a big metal sphere in the slot marked with three lights.

shrines.name: Kuh Takkar Shrine
shrines.solution: Melt the ice around the entrance first. Inside, carry an ice block past the fire columns to the door without letting it melt.

shrines.name: Sasa Kai Shrine
shrines.solution: At 3 pm, when Gerudo Tower's shadow covers the pedestal, shoot an arrow at the sun to reveal the shrine, then defeat the Guardian Scout III.

shrines.name: Sho Dantu Shrine
shrines.solution: Put a bomb on each launcher and blow it at the top to hit the caged Shock Switches in the first two rooms. In the last room, leave the square bomb in the cage and let the round one bounce, detonating one while you stand on a raised launcher and the other to reopen the gate. The chest is behind the pillar in the left room.

shrines.name: Suma Sahma Shrine
shrines.solution: At 4:00 PM, when the pedestal on Mount Granajh glows, cast the shadow of a snowball or Cryonis block onto it.

shrines.name: Goma Asaagh Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout IV; ice pillars from Cryonis on the wet floor make useful cover.

shrines.name: Hia Miu Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout IV; lift the metal floor blocks with Magnesis for cover.

shrines.name: Kiah Toza Shrine
shrines.solution: Guide the rolling orb down the contraption with Magnesis, Stasis, Cryonis and the floor switches until it lands in the final slot. Raise an ice pillar under the stone block at the back to reach a ladder up to the chest.

shrines.name: Maka Rah Shrine
shrines.solution: Light the second torch to open the gate, cross the spinning spiked column over the lava, and hit the switches through the following rooms. Get past the spiked boulders rolling down the final ramp to reach the monk at the top.

shrines.name: Mozo Shenno Shrine
shrines.solution: Glide northwest from the cedar on Talonto Peak to find the shrine under the Biron Snowshelf, then defeat the Guardian Scout IV, using Magnesis-lifted floor blocks as cover.

shrines.name: Noe Rajee Shrine
shrines.solution: Glide around the spinning pillar and hit the four switches hidden in it, each adding another wind gust. Ride the gusts to the top, then glide on to the chest and the monk.

shrines.name: Qaza Tokki Shrine
shrines.solution: Work through the North Lomei Labyrinth to the ladders and tunnel that lead to a walkway above the shrine, then drop down.

shrines.name: Rok Uwog Shrine
shrines.solution: Clear the vines by the barred window to reach the second room, beat the Guardian Scouts and lower the ramp. Lift the barrels off the switch, take the Small Key from the chest, and use it on the locked door in the first room. The other chest is on a ledge to the right of the entrance-facing wall.

shrines.name: Sha Warvo Shrine
shrines.solution: Ride the fan updrafts with the paraglider from platform to platform until you can glide to the monk; the walled fifth fan is reached through a small gap in its wall.

shrines.name: Shada Naw Shrine
shrines.solution: Let the fans push the orb across the moving platform onto the ramp, using the metal blocks to keep it from falling. Stand on the launcher when the orb fills the slot so it lifts you to the monk.

shrines.name: To Quomo Shrine
shrines.solution: Roll the big snowballs east of the giant stone door into it to smash it open, then enter the cave under the skeleton.

shrines.name: Rin Oyaa Shrine
shrines.solution: Block the two fans that blow the orb into a dead end with the metal blocks, then stand on the launcher when the orb reaches the slot to ride up to the monk. Put a metal block on the launcher to jump across to the chest opposite the monk.

shrines.name: Sha Gehma Shrine
shrines.solution: Free the chest pinned under the metal block on the rail and use its Small Key on the monk's portcullis.

shrines.name: Akh Va'quot Shrine
shrines.solution: Hit the switches to turn the six fans until every windmill spins at once. More chests wait in the pool room behind the elevator.

shrines.name: Bareeda Naag Shrine
shrines.solution: Load a round bomb into the cannon and detonate it to fire the orb past the moving platforms into the target. Bomb the cracked blocks near the entrance for one chest; hit the moving target with the second cannon past the monk for another.

shrines.name: Gee Ha'rah Shrine
shrines.solution: In the right-hand room, cut both ropes holding the stone ball so it drops straight onto the switch. The left-hand room's ball must be steered onto a wall switch to open the chest room.

shrines.name: Kah Okeo Shrine
shrines.solution: Take the Korok Leaf from the first chest and use it on Wind Switches and balloon platforms. Bomb the cracked wall to start the updraft, clear the upper walls with the floating bomb barrel, and ride the updraft up to the key that unlocks the monk's gate.

shrines.name: Lanno Kooh Shrine
shrines.solution: Cut down a tree and ride the log down the river past the falls to the shrine, or brave the icy water.

shrines.name: Rona Kachta Shrine
shrines.solution: Reach the shrine at the back of the Forgotten Temple, past the many Decayed Guardians.

shrines.name: Sheem Dagoze Shrine
shrines.solution: Shoot an arrow through two Stone Rings to raise the shrine. Inside, work the two floor switches to tilt the ramps so each Ancient Orb lands in a different socket.

shrines.name: Tena Ko'sah Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout IV among the breakable pillars to open the gate to the monk and the chest.

shrines.name: Voo Lota Shrine
shrines.solution: After the floor drops, glide into the fan and work across the platforms, gliding over and under the spike walls and riding fans, to a chest holding a small key, then return to unlock the monk's gate. A side platform near the end holds a second chest.

shrines.name: Dagah Keek Shrine
shrines.solution: Plunge-attack the Lightscale Trident or Ceremonial Trident straight down into the pedestal at Veiled Falls.

shrines.name: Ne'ez Yohma Shrine
shrines.solution: Climb the sloped waterfall while dodging the boulders and laser, then use Cryonis to shove the orb off the top so it rolls down into the pedestal by the gate. Drop from the side path onto a block midway down for the chest.

shrines.name: Sato Koda Shrine
shrines.solution: Guide the giant orb down the waterfall contraption with Cryonis paths and Stasis on the tilting slabs so the Launcher at the bottom sends it into the slot. Build ice steps to reach the chest above the slot.

shrines.name: Soh Kofi Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout II to open the gate; the chest is on the stairs up to the monk.

shrines.name: Kee Dafunia Shrine
shrines.solution: Melt ice with the lit torch to clear the way and to shape the launched blocks into steps up the pillar, then melt the last big block down until you can move it across the pool and use it with Cryonis to climb to the monk. Melt the ice behind the raised platform for the chest.

shrines.name: Shai Yota Shrine
shrines.solution: Bomb the cracked rocks around Horon Lagoon to start the wind, then glide on the big gust from the large island and land on the pedestal.

shrines.name: Daka Tuss Shrine
shrines.solution: Scoop an orb over the grate with the metal bowl via Magnesis. In the second room, rest an orb on top of the grate, then press the underwater switch with the bowl so it drops in and drains the pool, opening the way to the monk.

shrines.name: Kaya Wan Shrine
shrines.solution: Make ice blocks to climb the waterfall, then ride the raft down the river past the Guardian Scouts and glide from the final drop to the monk. Lift the gate on the river's left with a Cryonis pillar to reach a chest.

shrines.name: Jitan Sa'mi Shrine
shrines.solution: Shoot the glowing Malice eyes on Naydra around Mount Lanayru, shoot it once more for a scale, and offer the scale to the Spring of Wisdom.

shrines.name: Tahno O'ah Shrine
shrines.solution: Line up the three trees on Madorna Mountain, head due east, and bomb the rock wall blocking the cave.

shrines.name: Dow Na'eh Shrine
shrines.solution: Gather all three chests onto the giant floor switch (shoot the ropes to drop the shelf chest, then pull it out with Magnesis). Then use the metal box from the opened room with the launcher to get up to the monk.

shrines.name: Kah Yah Shrine
shrines.solution: Hold down the left corridor's floor switch with a barrel or Stasis to reach a chest with a small key, then unlock the monk's door. Holding the right switch opens the second chest.

shrines.name: Kam Urog Shrine
shrines.solution: Freeze the gears with Stasis to stop the rotating platforms and climb the cylinder, then line up a floating stair platform with the stairs near the top to reach the monk. One chest is in a wall opening; the other rides a rotating platform.

shrines.name: Muwo Jeem Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout III to open the portcullis to the monk.

shrines.name: Myahm Agana Shrine
shrines.solution: Tilt the platform to guide the orb through the maze and drop it into the slot, or flip the platform over and roll the orb across its flat underside. Tilt it and glide into the maze to reach the chest.

shrines.name: Tawa Jinn Shrine
shrines.solution: Take the orbs from the three Hinoxes on Mount Taran (by stealth or by fighting) and set them in the pedestals.

shrines.name: Yah Rin Shrine
shrines.solution: Load the scales with the shrine's metal objects to lift yourself to higher ledges until you reach the monk's pagoda.

shrines.name: Chaas Qeta Shrine
shrines.solution: Defeat the Guardian Scout IV to open the portcullis to the monk.

shrines.name: Korgu Chideh Shrine
shrines.solution: With all gear taken away, place Eventide Island's three orbs into its three pedestals to raise the shrine.

shrines.name: Ha Dahamar Shrine
shrines.solution: Pass the waterfalls with Cryonis, then place ice blocks on the wall to steer the rolling orb, pinball style, into the socket. The chest is on a ledge between the first two waterfalls.

shrines.name: Hila Rao Shrine
shrines.solution: Cross the drifting water channels, then time a Remote Bomb on the floating explosive barrels to break the stone wall at the far exit. One chest is underwater in the second channel; the other floats in the third.

shrines.name: Lakna Rokee Shrine
shrines.solution: Tail Dorian out of Kakariko at night, beat the Yiga Blademaster at the pedestal, and place the Sheikah Heirloom in its slot.

shrines.name: Qukah Nata Shrine
shrines.solution: Get lightning to strike the mound by Calora Lake by leaving a metal object on top of it.

shrines.name: Ree Dahee Shrine
shrines.solution: Use each switch to tilt the platforms so the orb rolls into its socket, which starts the next moving platform. The chest is above the last tilting platform.

shrines.name: Shai Utoh Shrine
shrines.solution: Freeze the tilting platforms with Stasis so you can climb them to the top. The first chest is up the right side at the second platform; the second sits above the monk and needs a big launch to glide to.

shrines.name: Shee Venath Shrine
shrines.solution: Move the five orbs on the grid to match the layout in Shee Vaneer Shrine on the other Dueling Peak; the viewing platform helps. Glide to the chest on the far wall ledge.

shrines.name: Shee Vaneer Shrine
shrines.solution: Arrange the five orbs on the grid to match the layout in Shee Venath Shrine on the other Dueling Peak; the viewing platform helps you see the grid. Glide to the chest on the far wall ledge.

shrines.name: Shoda Sah Shrine
shrines.solution: Launch orbs into both slots; each one fires a chest across the room. The left slot's chest has the small key for the door at the end of the bridge.

shrines.name: Ta'loh Naeg Shrine
shrines.solution: Follow the monk's lessons against the training Guardian Scout: side hop and flurry rush, backflip and flurry rush, a perfect guard, then a charged attack to finish it. Two chests sit by the elevator and one is behind the gate with the monk.

shrines.name: Toto Sah Shrine
shrines.solution: Rotate each platform with motion control to form a path, aligning the sliding stairway sections. On the last structure, grab the Small Key chest and open the monk's door; flip the first platform over to find a second chest.
